summary.text: S.J. Howell is a Democratic state representative who has represented Montana House District 100 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Howell previously worked as executive director of Montana Women Vote, a statewide nonprofit.

paragraphs.text: S.J. Howell was born in Billings, Montana, lives in Missoula, and earned an undergraduate degree from the University of Montana.
